main_gate.requirement: One effective K_256 must pass holdout RGB, perturbation and subset stability, independent sensor depth, rigidity and TCP checks before histories and MolmoMotion are rebuilt.

numbered_requirements.0_source_facts: verified in previous reports and raw episode files
numbered_requirements.2_frame_selection: surveyed vertical and horizontal episodes; train and holdout stored for diagnostic fits
numbered_requirements.3_physical_CAD_RGB_correspondences: unmet: no six repeatable physical points per diverse peg frame; board holes and rounded-outline intersections are derived features
numbered_requirements.4_annotation_repeatability: unmet as manual independent repeat marking; segmentation-threshold sensitivity and scenario perturbations are recorded instead
numbered_requirements.5_multiframe_bundle: performed for rounded peg, board, tabletop contact and RGB/TCP candidate models; none accepted
numbered_requirements.6_holdout_RGB: performed for candidates; low error does not identify metric K
numbered_requirements.7_K_stability: failed under 2 px and systematic feature perturbations
numbered_requirements.8_distortion: tested k1,k2; 0.023 px mean holdout gain is below annotation uncertainty
numbered_requirements.9_sensor_depth_crosscheck: performed independently after RGB candidate fits; leading board-only K has 38.14 mm board Z error; other candidates have unstable K
numbered_requirements.10_rigidity: diagnostic old and candidate sensor histories compared; no validated-K history exists
numbered_requirements.11_TCP: RGB/TCP tip and silhouette diagnostics tested; fixed RGB/CAD K candidates give similar heldout tip error and cannot be selected by this check
numbered_requirements.12_K_comparison: completed as diagnostic K_comparison.csv; no winner declared
numbered_requirements.13_K_acceptance: failed: joint validation criteria not met
numbered_requirements.14_unidentified_K_followup: tested more frames, three horizontal peg poses, table contact, RGB/TCP metric motion and planar board model; still unresolved
numbered_requirements.15_rebuild_histories: not started because validated-K gate failed
numbered_requirements.16_four_model_runs: not started because validated-K histories do not exist
numbered_requirements.17_recalibrated_2D_metrics: not computed; prior ADE/FDE marked PRE_CALIBRATION / CONDITIONAL
numbered_requirements.18_old_vs_new_table: new columns cannot be populated without validated-K runs
numbered_requirements.19_interpretation: conditional: present disagreement cannot be attributed specifically to calibration
numbered_requirements.20_leakage: no future evaluation GT or MolmoMotion ADE/FDE was used to estimate or select K
numbered_requirements.21_artifacts: diagnostic calibration and comparison artifacts plus common report exist; validated-K and new-inference artifacts are absent by gate
numbered_requirements.23_completion_questions: question 1 unresolved; questions 2 and 3 require a validated K and therefore remain unanswered

next_required_external_anchor: Active COLOR intrinsics plus the recorded 640x480-to-256x256 transform, or RGB of a metric structure at several genuinely different tilts with unambiguous physical points.
